title: SHyMA: Sounding-rocket Hypersonic Mission Analysis (v2.5.1)
description:
SHyMA is a framework of computationally light engineering models for the pre-Phase A mission analysis of hypersonic (scramjet) flight experiments boosted by sounding rockets: stakeholder test window, pseudo-5-DOF ascent and point-mass flight over the WGS-84 Earth, inverse design of the launch settings (deterministic or under uncertainty), residual-dispersion Monte Carlo, hot-wall stagnation heating, telemetry coverage and useful test time.

This archive contains the code, the public input data (VSB-30 flight table, HyShot 2 re-entry state, NASA NESC check-case reference trajectories), the result files behind every number of the accompanying article, test cases that reproduce it, and a single-file browser workbench. It accompanies the article "Requirement-driven pre-Phase A mission analysis of sounding-rocket-boosted scramjet flight experiments" (submitted to Acta Astronautica).
